description: Track pantry items with quantities and expiry dates; items expiring soon are highlighted.

faqs.a: Enter the item name, quantity, unit, and expiry date, then click Add Item.
faqs.q: How do I add a pantry item?

faqs.a: Items expiring within 7 days get a yellow highlight; expired items get a red one.
faqs.q: What does the expiring-soon highlight mean?

faqs.a: Use the + / − buttons on each row to adjust the quantity without retyping it.
In this browser's localStorage — private to this device.

howto: Enter the item name, quantity and unit.
Pick an expiry date (or leave blank for non-perishables).
Click Add Item — soon-to-expire items are highlighted automatically.
Use + / − to adjust quantities, or delete finished items.
title: Pantry Inventory
